title: Cylindrical body
spec: Begin by setting up a new coordinate system with Euler angles of zero and a translation vector of zero. Next, create a two-dimensional sketch on a single face within this coordinate system. Within this face, draw a single loop, and inside this loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates (0.0234, 0.0234) with a radius of 0.0234. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0469 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to adjust its size. Transform this scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it according to the Euler angles and translating it using the translation vector defined earlier. Extrude the transformed two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a three-dimensional cylindrical body. Ensure that the extrusion does not extend in the opposite direction. Finally, perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The resulting cylindrical body will have a length of 0.046875 units, a width of 0.046875 units, and a height of 0.7500000000000001 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the circular face
circle_center = (0.0234, 0.0234)
circle_radius = 0.0234

# Create the circle in the sketch
workplane = workplane.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical object
extrude_depth = 0.75
extrude_depth_opposite_normal = 0.0

# Perform the extrusion
workplane = workplane.extrude(extrude_depth)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
r = workplane

# Display the final model

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0234, 0.0234)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0234)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
